name: Prologue
speaker: grandpa
desc: You wake up in the scrapyard. Grandpa is tinkering with a broken generator nearby. Another day in the Scrapyard District.

name: Getting Organized
speaker: grandpa
desc: Grandpa nods approvingly at your new sorting station. 'Your father used to keep things organized too,' he says, looking away.

name: The Workshop Awakens
speaker: grandpa
desc: As the workshop powers up for the first time in years, you notice scratches on the workbench — measurements, notes, a name: your father's.

name: Father's Legacy
speaker: grandpa
desc: Behind the rusted door, covered in dust and cobwebs, stands a mecha. Small, old, battered — but unmistakably your father's first build. The cockpit still has his callsign etched into the frame.

name: Turning Junk Into Future
speaker: grandpa
desc: The refinery hums to life. Grandpa watches from the doorway. 'He always said this machine would change everything,' he whispers. 'He wasn't wrong.'

name: First Schematic
speaker: system
desc: You study the Nano Infra schematics. The engineering is elegant — far beyond what you'd expect from street tech. Where did these come from?

name: The Bazaar
speaker: system
desc: The Neon Bazaar is everything they warned you about — and more. Holographic vendors, whispered deals, and the unmistakable scent of opportunity.

name: The Empty Workshop
speaker: system
desc: The workshop is quieter now. The tools are where he left them. The bench he built forty years ago still stands against the wall. Some things outlast the people who made them.

name: Routines
speaker: system
desc: The sorting station runs. The refinery hums. The scrapyard does what it was built to do. You keep working. It's what he would have wanted.

name: Father's Debt
speaker: ironjaw_enforcer
desc: The enforcer drops a dataslate on the workbench without a word. The number is not small. 'Your old man borrowed from us. You're his blood. You figure it out.' He walks out. The door doesn't close all the way.

choices.label: Pay what you can
choices.desc: Buy time. Compliance now, options later.
choices.log: You hand over what you have. The clock keeps ticking.

choices.label: Refuse — it's not your debt
choices.desc: Stand your ground. Escalation is likely.
choices.log: You close the door they left open. The Ironjaw won't forget.

name: The Covenant Extends a Hand
speaker: covenant_liaison
desc: A message arrives through an Underground contact. No sender. Just a frequency and a time window. 'We've observed your operational profile. The Steel Covenant has infrastructure. You have potential. This arrangement benefits both parties.' Someone with resources is paying attention.

choices.label: Hear them out
choices.desc: Information is leverage. Learn what they want.
choices.log: You acknowledge the contact. The Covenant notes your response.

choices.label: Refuse contact
choices.desc: Keep distance. Some hands you don't shake.
choices.log: You drop the frequency. Autonomy maintained — for now.

name: Nephilim in the Yard
speaker: kenji
desc: They weren't just salvaging. I've seen scan patterns like that before — systematic, targeted. Someone hired them to look for something specific. Something in this yard. Something they already know exists. We need to figure out what before they come back with more.
